name: Antaryatra : An Inner Journey
description: Antaryatra - An Inner Journey Preeti Banerjee Get your tickets here. “Antaryatra – An Inner Journey,” is a thematically curated presentation of the traditional Odissi repertoire, choreographed by the legendary Guru Kelucharan Mahapatra. The performance unfolds as a spiritual journey through four classical compositions, seamlessly tracing the path from invocation and celebration to devotion and ultimately, liberation. The recital includes: Mangalacharan – Shantakaram: An invocation to Lord Vishnu, seeking peace and divine blessings. Bilahari Pallavi: A pure dance composition that celebrates the beauty, rhythm, and lyrical movement of Odissi. Ahe Nilo Sailo: An expressive Odia abhinaya based on the celebrated composition of the 17th-century poet Salabega, reflecting unwavering devotion to Lord Jagannath and the universality of faith. Moksha: The concluding piece symbolizing spiritual liberation and transcendence. About Preeti Banerjee Preeti Banerjee, stepped into the world of Odissi under Smt. Arpita Venkatesh at her native in Kolkata and is continuing her training under her. She is the Director- Cultural Events of MEDAI The Stage Bengaluru, one of the Black Box Theatre in Chennai, Bangalore & Coimbatore. She was under the training of Smt. Sharmila Mukherjee at Sanjali Centre for Odissi Dance for a while after moving to Bangalore. Dancing Career The first breakthrough milestone in her dancing career came in the form of an award from All India Dance Drama & Music Festival (Cuttack Mahotsav) organized by Utkala Yuva Sanskrutik Sangh, Cuttack Orissa, where she was also honored with “NRITYA SHREE”. She continued to sculpt herself into a fine dancer by taking further training under the able guidance of Guru Aloka Kanungo. The next achievement was her performance in KONARK DANCE FESTIVAL, Orissa. After this there was no looking back for her as she won many prizes in a number of prestigious competitions all over India. She has performed in various festivals like “MUKTESHWAR FESTIVAL, Bhubaneswar”, “KALA GHODA DANCE FESTIVAL, Mumbai”, “UDAY SHANKAR DANCE FESTIVAL, Kolkata, “SOORYA FESTIVAL, Kerala” and many more. Internationally , she has performed for ‘Festival of India’ in Tunisia organised by the Ministry of Culture, India and Indian Embassy, Tunisia. Also, on the occasion Republic Day Celebration in Seychelles organised by ICCR as an ensemble member of Sanjali Centre for Odissi Dance. She has been fortunate also to train through the workshops under the renowned Odissi exponents like Dr.Sonal Mansingh, Smt. Sujata Mohapatra and many more. Apart from her dancing career academically she has completed her graduation degree from Calcutta University and post-graduation from IHM, Kolkata. She has also received a certificate of excellence from the Department of Parliament Affairs.

name: Dispatch : letters to the living - Avani Films
description: Avani Films Dispatch: letters to the living Directed by Anu Vaidyanathan Get your tickets here. Following the death of her beloved mother-in-law—a mathematician and refugee from pre-Partition Punjab—filmmaker Anu Vaidyanathan embarks on a deeply personal journey across India. Bridging North and South India, Dispatch: Letters to the Living weaves together the lives of her mother and mother-in-law to examine marriage, grief, motherhood, and the invisible labor passed down through generations. Equal parts visual poem and intimate inquiry, the documentary reflects on what women are expected to leave behind as they move between families—and how their stories endure. Avani Films Founded by filmmaker and author Anu Vaidyanathan, Avani Films is an independent production house dedicated to subversive, layered, and boundary-pushing non-fiction cinema. Operating across India and internationally, the company champions intimate, women-led storytelling that explores themes of memory, grief, migration, and invisible labor. Its debut feature documentary, Dispatch: Letters to the Living, premiered on the international festival circuit alongside an expanding slate of documentaries and short films.https://www.avanifilms.com/ Anu Vaidyanathan Anu Vaidyanathan is an Indian filmmaker, author, comedian, and former endurance athlete whose work blends sharp personal inquiry with lyrical visual storytelling. A PhD in Electrical Engineering turned creative polymath, she made history as the first Indian to complete the Ultraman triathlon before publishing her acclaimed memoir, Anywhere But Home. Through her production banner, Avani Films, she writes, directs, and produces cross-cultural documentaries and narrative shorts—including her debut feature documentary, Dispatch: Letters to the Living—exploring identity, motherhood, and familial memory.

name: Manasa Shastry : Hindustani Vocal Recital
description: Get Your tickets here Manasa Shastry Manasa Shastry is a Bangalore-based Hindustani Classical Vocalist. She has trained under well-known Guru, Vidushi Geetha Hegde, in her earlier years. She later sought guidance from, and is the disciple of the renowned harmonium player and Agra gharana vocalist, Pandit Vyasmurti Katti. Manasa is a graduate of MSc Industrial Chemistry from MS Ramaiah College Bangalore, and more recently, she has completed her MA in Hindustani Vocal Music from Bharati Vidyapeeth in Pune, emerging as one of the top performers in the college. Manasa has received many accolades for her sensitive and nuanced approach to the artform of vocal music, the foremost of which would be the coveted NCPA scholarship for young artistes, in the year 2020. She is also the recipient of the Pritibhakankshi Award for young vocalists, instituted by the Sri Ram Seva Mandali, Fort High School, Bangalore. She is a graded artiste of the All India Radio. She has performed at various music festivals and baithaks in Bangalore, Kochi, Udupi, Hubli, Bekal, Varanasi as well as the Margazhi Festival in Chennai. In the year 2022, she was part of a select group of performers chosen by the ICCR to perform all over Germany, sponsored by the Government of India. Sagar Bharatraj Sagar is an exemplar of the culmination of art and science. He is the son and disciple of his Pt. Bharathraj Venkat Rao a renowned tabla artiste in Kerala. Sagar started his tabla journey under his aegis and still takes lessons from him. Throughout his academic career, Sagar managed to balance his love of music with his mastery over academics. A triple gold medalist from the BTech stream at NIT Calicut and later from MTech and PhD at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) Bangalore, he has proved his mettle as a researcher too. He is currently the Associate Director at Samsung Advanced Institute of Technology. Apart from continuing to study under his father, Sagar also sought the guidance of Pt. Ravindra Yavagal. He has also been fortunate to be under the auspices of Smt. Aditi Upadhya, a doyenne of the Agra gharana for direction in vocal accompaniment. Sagar has a variegated list of accomplishments: national award winner for best Masters thesis, accompanist to many scholarly musicians, guest speaker at MIT, Montpellier, and other universities, several international patents and publications in journals of extensive repute. He is known for his perceptive, unobtrusive and dexterous style of playing. He attempts to delve deeper into the rewarding depths of music with his anchor firmly rooted in a career of scientific research. Vighnesh Bhagavat Hindustani Classical Vocalist & Harmonium Accompanist Vighnesh Bhagavat Yellapur is a distinguished Hindustani Classical Vocalist and Harmonium accompanist. He began his musical journey under the guidance of Vidwan Dattatraya Gaonkar of Yellapur and is currently receiving advanced training from the renowned harmonium maestro Pandit Vyasamurti Katti. He completed his Bachelor of Music (B.Music) from Karnataka Fine Arts and Music College, Dharwad, and earned his Master of Music (M.Music) in Hindustani Vocal from KSGH Music and Fine Arts University, Mysore. Academic Excellence: Awarded Four Gold Medals during his Master's studies in recognition of outstanding academic achievement. Vighnesh has performed alongside several eminent musicians and has accompanied numerous acclaimed and emerging artists on prestigious stages. He is widely appreciated for his sensitive accompaniment, refined artistry, and deep understanding of the nuances of Indian Raga Music. Combining technical excellence with musical maturity, Vighnesh continues to contribute to the rich tradition of Hindustani Classical Music as both a performer and educator.
